statements:
CREATE TABLE account_history (
  history_id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  id UUID NOT NULL,
  _version BIGINT NOT NULL,
  operation TEXT NOT NULL,
  "data" JSONB NOT NULL,
  recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT clock_timestamp() NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT account_history_pkey PRIMARY KEY (history_id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE account_history IS 'Version history for account'

steps.subject: table/account/column/_version

statements: CREATE INDEX idx_account_history_id_recorded ON account_history USING BTREE (id, recorded_at)
steps.subject: table/account_history/index/idx_account_history_id_recorded

statements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_account_history_id_version ON account_history USING BTREE (id, _version)
steps.subject: table/account_history/index/uq_account_history_id_version
function/account_capture_history

hazards.reason: Seeding account_history writes one image of every row of account while the new triggers' lock blocks writes to it.
hazards.subject: table/account_history

statements:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_account_bump_version
  BEFORE UPDATE ON account
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION account_capture_history()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_account_capture_history_write
  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON account
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION account_capture_history()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_account_capture_history_delete
  AFTER DELETE ON account
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION account_capture_history()

INSERT INTO account_history (id, _version, operation, data)
SELECT src.id, src._version, 'INSERT', to_jsonb(src)
FROM account AS src
